subject: general
question: Find the cost (in ₹) of digging a cuboidal pit that is 6 m long, 64 m broad and 10 m deep at the rate of ₹15 per m³.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Volume** of **cuboidal pit** = Length × Breadth × Depth

**Total Cost** = Volume × Rate

Calculation: (6 × 64 × 10) × 15 = 3840 × 15

Total Cost = ₹57,600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹57,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length (l)** = 6 m

**Breadth (b)** = 64 m

**Depth (h)** = 10 m

**Rate** of digging = ₹15 per m³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2b6985bd9547e0ea2362183aa0c50370f6b63202bda82cfa1711c93073e5484.png] 

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of Cuboid** = l × b × h

**Total Cost** = Volume × Rate per unit volume

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 6 × 64 × 10

⇒ Volume = 384 × 10 = 3840 m³

⇒ Total Cost = 3840 × 15

⇒ Total Cost = ₹57,600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹57,600.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Cuboid

The **Total Surface Area (TSA)** is given by 2(lb + bh + lh) and **Lateral Surface Area (LSA)** is 2h(l + b).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The length of the **longest rod** that can be placed inside a cuboid is √(l² + b² + h²).

Volume of a Cube

For a cube where all sides are equal (a), the **volume** is a³ and the **Total Surface Area** is 6a².
